name: scrutiny-collector-performance
description: Scrutiny Performance Benchmark Collector (Hub/Spoke mode). Runs fio benchmarks on drives and tracks throughput, IOPS, and latency over time. Requires a running Scrutiny web server instance. Use the omnibus template instead if you want an all-in-one deployment. You must add each drive as a Device in the container settings. Alternatively, toggle Privileged mode to ON in the Unraid Docker UI to grant access to all drives automatically (less secure).

paths.name: Udev
paths.description: Required for device detection. Do not change.

variables.name: API Endpoint
variables.description: Scrutiny web server URL (e.g. http://scrutiny-web:8080). Required.

variables.name: Host ID
variables.description: Unique identifier for this collector host.

variables.name: Cron Schedule
variables.description: Performance benchmark schedule (cron format). Default: Sunday at 2 AM.

variables.name: Run on Startup
variables.description: Run performance benchmarks immediately on container startup.

variables.name: Profile
variables.description: Benchmark profile: 'quick' (~60s per device) or 'comprehensive' (~300s per device).

devices.name: Disk 1
devices.description: First disk to benchmark. Add more Device entries for additional disks. For NVMe, pass both /dev/nvme0 (controller) and /dev/nvme0n1 (namespace).
